import re

path = 'unpacked/word/document.xml'
with open(path, encoding='ascii') as f:
    xml = f.read()

HEADLINES = [
    'EXECUTIVE SUMMARY',
    'FINANCIAL HIGHLIGHTS',
    'REVENUE BREAKDOWN BY SEGMENT',
    'KEY PERFORMANCE INDICATORS',
    'OPERATING EXPENSES',
    'Q1 2025 OUTLOOK',
    'RISK FACTORS',
]

count = 0
for title in HEADLINES:
    pattern = re.compile(
        r'(<w:rPr>)(.*?)(</w:rPr>\s*<w:t xml:space="preserve">'
        + re.escape(title) + r'</w:t>)',
        re.DOTALL,
    )
    xml, n = pattern.subn(r'\1\2<w:u w:val="single"/>\3', xml)
    count += n
    if n == 0:
        print('WARNING: headline not found:', title)

with open(path, 'w', encoding='ascii') as f:
    f.write(xml)

print('Underlined', count, 'headline runs')
PYEOF

import re

path = 'unpacked/word/document.xml'
with open(path, encoding='ascii') as f:
    xml = f.read()

# All-caps section headlines in the report
HEADLINES = [
    'EXECUTIVE SUMMARY',
    'FINANCIAL HIGHLIGHTS',
    'REVENUE BREAKDOWN BY SEGMENT',
    'KEY PERFORMANCE INDICATORS',
    'OPERATING EXPENSES',
    'Q1 2025 OUTLOOK',
    'RISK FACTORS',
]

count = 0
for title in HEADLINES:
    # Insert <w:u w:val="single"/> inside the <w:rPr> of the run that
    # contains exactly this headline text.
    pattern = re.compile(
        r'(<w:rPr>)(.*?)(</w:rPr>\s*<w:t xml:space="preserve">'
        + re.escape(title) + r'</w:t>)',
        re.DOTALL,
    )
    xml, n = pattern.subn(r'\1\2<w:u w:val="single"/>\3', xml)
    count += n
    if n == 0:
        print('WARNING: headline not found:', title)

with open(path, 'w', encoding='ascii') as f:
    f.write(xml)

print('Underlined', count, 'headline runs')
